design.concept: A landing for the team manager: one calm header with the pending volume as a highlighted number, and right below it the inbox of expenses waiting for their decision. Each row says who registered it, when, the category, the amount and whether it is a resubmission after a correction, and has one clear way into the analysis.
design.decisions: One view, so no scene host. The page is the entry point of an approval flow, not the decision itself, so per the template's 'forbidden' list there are no approve/reject buttons on rows: each row only offers navigation to the analysis (abrirAnaliseDespesas with the row id), where the reading-then-deciding flow happens. The pending total is a metric card at the top right of the header (volume first), and the table is the primary content. Resubmissions are a quiet info badge, not alarm color. Loading, empty (a calm 'nothing waiting' statement), error (inside the region, with retry) and 'load more' paging are designed. Only the row button navigates, to avoid a double trigger with row click. Money and dates are displayed from the contract fields with Intl, with nothing computed. List shape is read defensively (items/hasMore) because the declaration only exposes the list type by name. Fix: the pt-br catalogue is no longer `as const`, so the other locales can type against string values.
